disclaimer.title: Your file never leaves your browser
disclaimer.body: Encryption, decryption and storage happen locally. Files travel only over a direct, end-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer channel between browsers — never through a server. The key is derived from your wallet signature: only the account that encrypted a file can unlock it.

connect.title: Connect your Radix Wallet
connect.subtitle: Encrypting binds the file to your account: only a signature from this account will be able to unlock it later.

modes.label: Encryption method
modes.rolaDescription: Sign a challenge with your Radix Wallet; the encryption key is derived from that signature.

file.label: File to encrypt
file.prompt: Drop any file here or click to browse. No size limit — it is processed in chunks and never uploaded.
file.encPrompt: Drop a .radixenc file here or click to browse.
file.invalid: This is not a valid .radixenc file.

encrypt.readyHint: Download the encrypted copy for safekeeping, or share it directly with a receiver over a secure channel.

progress.signing: Confirm the request in your Radix Wallet…
progress.waitingPeer: Waiting for the other side to open the link…
progress.waitingApproval: Request sent. Waiting for the sender to approve and sign…
progress.waitingRequest: Transfer complete. Waiting for the decrypt request…
progress.keySent: Key sent. The receiver can now decrypt the file. You can close this page.

share.title: Share this link
share.hintReceive: Send this link to the person who should receive the file. When they open it, a direct encrypted channel is created and the file is transferred browser-to-browser.
share.hintUnlock: Send this link to the person who encrypted the file (e.g. via WhatsApp). When they open it and sign with their wallet, your file will be decrypted here.
share.qrAlt: QR code with the share link

receiver.namePlaceholder: Shown to the sender when you request decryption
receiver.personaHint: Using the name from your connected wallet persona.

localDecrypt.title: You encrypted this file
localDecrypt.hint: The connected account matches the one that encrypted this file. You can decrypt it right here by signing with your wallet.
localDecrypt.button: I am the sender: decrypt here

unlock.title: Decrypt request
unlock.gateSubtitle: Connect the wallet account that encrypted this file to approve the request.
unlock.wrongAccount: The connected account does not match the one that encrypted this file. Expected: {account}
unlock.done: Key sent. {name} can now decrypt the file. You can close this page.

errors.no_proof: The wallet did not return a signature proof.
errors.challenge_mismatch: The wallet signed a different challenge. Please try again.
errors.secp256k1: This account uses a secp256k1 key. Encryption requires a Babylon account (curve25519) so the key can be re-derived deterministically.
errors.origin_mismatch: This file was encrypted on a different site ({origin}) and cannot be unlocked here.
errors.network_mismatch: This file was encrypted on a different network.
errors.account_mismatch: The connected account is not the one that encrypted this file.
errors.header_mismatch: The request does not match the file shared in this session.
errors.decrypt_failed: Decryption failed: wrong key or corrupted file.
errors.peer_disconnected: The connection to the other side was lost. Ask them to reopen the link and try again.
errors.room_busy: Someone already joined this link. Each link works for a single session.
errors.signaling_unavailable: Could not reach the signaling service. Check your connection and try again.
errors.storage_quota: Not enough browser storage to hold this file.
errors.invalid_container: This is not a valid .radixenc file.
errors.webrtc_failed: Could not establish a direct connection between browsers. Try again, ideally with both devices on networks that allow peer-to-peer traffic.
errors.file_read: The file could not be read.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

security.title: How it works
security.boundToAccount: The key is derived from a deterministic wallet signature, so it is bound to the encrypting account, this site and this network.
security.headerVisible: The encrypted file keeps the original file name and the sender account visible in its header — share it only with people who may see that.
security.neverUploaded: File contents never touch a server: they stay in your browser and travel only over the direct encrypted channel.

cipher.leaveWarning: A transfer session is active. If you leave, the other side will be disconnected.
